conversation.content: What is the current proof-of-reserves ratio for BTC and ETH in the August 1, 2026 audit?
In the August 1, 2026 audit, BTC has a reserve ratio of 104.98% (48,500 BTC reserve vs 46,200 BTC liabilities) and ETH has a reserve ratio of 105.48% (385,000 ETH reserve vs 365,000 ETH liabilities).
How much of total BTC reserves are held in cold storage?
94.5% of total BTC reserves are held in BitGo cold storage custody.
